title: Cinquieme Solo De Concert Op. 91
identity: Jean-Baptiste Singelée's Cinquième Solo de concert, Op.91, is an E-flat alto saxophone and piano work. BnF identifies Adolphe Sax as original publisher in 1864, and records the score as consultable in Gallica. IMSLP lists the corresponding BnF scan as six-page score and three-page saxophone part, in E-flat major, dedicated to Monsieur Sellenik. The scan download did not render in this pass, so notation remains uninspected.

evidence.claim: BnF catalog record identifies the work as the fifth solo de concert, Op.91, for E-flat alto saxophone and piano, published by Adolphe Sax in 1864 and consultable on Gallica.

IMSLP entry links BnF/Gallica scans of the complete score and E-flat saxophone part, states Adolphe Sax plate A.S.95, six score pages, three part pages, E-flat major, and dedication to Monsieur Sellenik.
Attempted to retrieve the public BnF scan through IMSLP's public PDF path; returned an HTML verification page instead of PDF, so notation could not be inspected.
Swiss Youth Music Competition 2026 program lists a saxophone competitor performing the work.
Direct request to the public Gallica PDF returned HTTP 403, including an escalated retrieval attempt; notation could not be inspected.
